lines.text: Hoshea son of Elah reigned in Samaria nine years and did evil, though not like earlier kings.
Hoshea conspired to send envoys to King So of Egypt and withheld tribute, so Assyria's king imprisoned him.
After a three-year siege, Assyria's king captured Samaria and settled the Israelites in Halah, Gozan, and the Hittites' cities.
The Israelites abandoned all the LORD's commandments, made two cast idols of calves and an Asherah pole, and served Baal.
The LORD removed Israel from His presence, leaving only Ephraim, and Jeroboam led Israel away from Him.
